summary: Practise materiality, evidence testing, controls and workpaper documentation under ISSA 5000. Explore the course and build engagement-ready skills.
lede: Sustainability assurance training helps auditors and reporting leads plan engagements that test sustainability information against suitable criteria. Participants practise materiality and risk assessment, criteria mapping, evidence selection and documentation, control testing, and evaluation of exceptions. The course is for external and internal auditors, finance controllers and sustainability reporting leads who need to connect disclosures, procedures, evidence and conclusions under ISSA 5000.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, perform, review or oversee sustainability assurance work and need practical engagement methods grounded in ISSA 5000.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with auditing, assurance engagements or sustainability reporting is expected. No programming is required.
